svg.title: QuantumShield demo topology
svg.desc: Three nginx services (orders, payments, inventory), each with a QuantumShield sidecar sharing its network namespace. A client reaches the orders sidecar on :8443 over TLS 1.3 with X25519MLKEM768 (policy prefer, ML-DSA-65 server certificate). The orders sidecar's egress listeners on 127.0.0.1:9001 and :9002 carry orders' calls to the payments and inventory sidecars over hybrid mutual TLS (X25519MLKEM768, ML-DSA-65 certificates with SPIFFE IDs, policy strict, allow-list and revocation). Each service keeps its legacy TLS on 127.0.0.1:443; port 443 is refused from the network.
